title: Task Creation - Title
description: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a title.
acceptance_criteria: Verify a task can be saved with a non-empty title string.
Verify the title is correctly displayed in the task list.

verse: FR-01: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a title, description, due date, and priority level (low, medium, high).

title: Task Creation - Description
description: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a description.
acceptance_criteria: Verify a task can be saved with a description field.
Verify the description is correctly displayed in the task details view.

verse: FR-01: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a title, description, due date, and priority level (low, medium, high).

title: Task Creation - Due Date
description: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a due date.
acceptance_criteria: Verify a task can be saved with a valid date value.
Verify the due date is correctly stored and displayed.

verse: FR-01: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a title, description, due date, and priority level (low, medium, high).

title: Task Creation - Priority Level
description: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a priority level (low, medium, high).
acceptance_criteria: Verify the system accepts 'low', 'medium', and 'high' as valid priority levels.
Verify the system rejects priority levels outside of the specified set.

verse: FR-01: The system shall allow users to create tasks with a title, description, due date, and priority level (low, medium, high).

title: Task Assignment
description: The system shall allow users to assign tasks to team members.
acceptance_criteria: Verify a user can select a team member from a list and assign them to a task.
Verify the assigned team member is correctly associated with the task in the database.

verse: FR-02: The system shall allow users to assign tasks to team members.

title: Email Notification - Task Assignment
description: The system shall send email notifications when a task is assigned.
acceptance_criteria: Verify an email is triggered immediately upon task assignment.
Verify the email recipient is the assigned team member.

verse: FR-03: The system shall send email notifications when a task is assigned or when a due date is within 24 hours.

title: Email Notification - Due Date Proximity
description: The system shall send email notifications when a due date is within 24 hours.
acceptance_criteria: Verify an email is sent when the current time is <= 24 hours from the task due date.
Verify no notification is sent if the due date is > 24 hours away.

verse: FR-03: The system shall send email notifications when a task is assigned or when a due date is within 24 hours.

title: Task Filtering - Status
description: The system shall allow users to filter tasks by status (todo, in-progress, done).
acceptance_criteria: Verify selecting 'todo' returns only tasks with 'todo' status.
Verify selecting 'in-progress' returns only tasks with 'in-progress' status.
Verify selecting 'done' returns only tasks with 'done' status.

verse: FR-04: The system shall allow users to filter tasks by status (todo, in-progress, done) and priority.

title: Task Filtering - Priority
description: The system shall allow users to filter tasks by priority.
acceptance_criteria: Verify selecting a specific priority level returns only tasks matching that level.
Verify multiple filters (status and priority) can be applied simultaneously.

verse: FR-04: The system shall allow users to filter tasks by status (todo, in-progress, done) and priority.

title: Dashboard - Weekly Statistics
description: The system shall provide a dashboard showing task completion statistics for the current week.
acceptance_criteria: Verify the dashboard displays statistics (e.g., count of completed tasks).
Verify the data displayed is strictly limited to the current calendar week.

verse: FR-05: The system shall provide a dashboard showing task completion statistics for the current week.

title: API Response Latency
description: The system shall respond to API requests within 500ms under normal load.
acceptance_criteria: Verify 95th percentile of API response times is <= 500ms during normal load testing.
Verify response time is measured from request receipt to response transmission.

verse: NFR-01: The system shall respond to API requests within 500ms under normal load.

title: Concurrent User Capacity
description: The system shall support up to 100 concurrent users.
acceptance_criteria: Verify system stability and performance when 100 users are performing simultaneous actions.
Verify no service degradation or errors occur at the 100-user threshold.

verse: NFR-02: The system shall support up to 100 concurrent users.

title: System Availability
description: The system shall be available 99.9% of the time.
acceptance_criteria: Verify uptime percentage over a 30-day period is >= 99.9%.
Verify total downtime does not exceed 43.2 minutes per month.

verse: NFR-03: The system shall be available 99.9% of the time.

title: Password Security - Hashing
description: User passwords shall be stored using bcrypt hashing.
acceptance_criteria: Verify that the database does not contain plain-text passwords.
Verify that the stored password string follows the bcrypt format/prefix.

verse: NFR-04: User passwords shall be stored using bcrypt hashing.

title: GDPR Compliance
description: The system shall comply with GDPR data protection requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Verify existence of data deletion (Right to be Forgotten) functionality.
Verify existence of data export (Data Portability) functionality.
Verify user consent mechanisms are implemented for data processing.

verse: NFR-05: The system shall comply with GDPR data protection requirements.
